blocks.text: Derived (associated) lipids simple aur compound lipids ki hydrolysis se banne wale products hain, jin mein lipids wali properties (khoobiyan) hoti hain, maslan fatty acids, glycerol, steroids aur lipid mein ghulne wale vitamins. Yeh khud fats nahi, balke fats se bante hain. Jism mein in ke ahem kaam hain: energy aur hormones banana, cell ki structure, nerves (asaab) ki sehat aur vitamins ka kaam.

Steroids fatty acids se nahi bante, lekin in mein lipids jaisi kuch properties hoti hain. In mein teen cyclohexane rings (chhe carbon wale) aur aik cyclopentane ring (paanch carbon wala) aapas mein fused (jure hue) hote hain; is structure ko steroid nucleus kehte hain (Figure 27.12). Steroid nucleus ke chaar rings ke naam A, B, C aur D hain. Bohat se steroids mein –OH functional group bhi hota hai, is liye woh alcohols ki qism (sterols) mein aate hain. Jaandaron mein bohat se steroids hain, jaise cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D aur steroid hormones.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Cholesterol woh raw material (khaam maal) hai jis se jism steroid hormones banata hai, jab ke kuch doosre hormones (jaise insulin) amino acids se bane proteins hain. Is tarah cholesterol aur amino acids dono hormones ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Steroid nucleus: teen chhe atoms wali rings A, B aur C aur aik paanch atoms wali ring D aapas mein jure, A/B ke jor aur C/D ke jor par CH3 group, aur ring D par R.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.12: Steroid ki ring structure (kitab ki Figure 27.12 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Terpenes
blocks.text: Paudon mein milne wale lipids mein hydrocarbons ki aik bari variety hai jinhein terpenes kehte hain; yeh isoprene units se bante hain. Isoprene ka formula CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂ hai (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene, 5 carbon).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab isoprene ka formula 'CH(CH)₃=CH-CH₂CH₃' chhapti hai, jo ghalat hai. Sahi formula CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂ hai: is mein do double bonds hain aur kul 5 carbon.
In hydrocarbons aur un ke oxygen wale derivatives mein 40 se kam carbon atoms hote hain. Jin terpenes mein 40 carbon atoms hon unhein carotenoids kehte hain (jaise gajar ka laal-narangi rang).

blocks.alt: Limonene ki skeletal structure: chhe atoms wali ring jis mein aik C=C double bond aur double bond wale carbon par methyl group; saamne wale ring carbon se hashed bond aik carbon tak jata hai jis par methyl group aur =CH2 group hain. Label: limonene (a terpene).
blocks.caption: Limonene (aik terpene) (topic 27.4.4 ke saath chhapi structure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Limonene lemon mein milne wala terpene hai. Is mein 10 carbon atoms hain, yani do isoprene units (har aik 5 carbon). Ring mein aik C=C hai aur bahar wale group mein doosra C=C (=CH₂).

blocks.prompt: Steroid nucleus ke chaar rings aur un ke size batayein.
blocks.explanation: A, B aur C chhe carbon wale (cyclohexane) rings hain aur D paanch carbon wala (cyclopentane) ring hai.

items: Derived lipids: fatty acids, glycerol, steroids, lipid mein ghulne wale vitamins.
Steroid nucleus: teen cyclohexane + aik cyclopentane ring (A, B, C, D); cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D, hormones.
Terpenes isoprene (C₅) units se bante hain (limonene); 40 carbon wale terpenes carotenoids hain.
